label: C-MOON-M4-NF2
title: Native execution fabric -- Moonshot epochs on PostgreSQL + Fabric + Pan's lake (OP-NF2)
objective: Replace Git-CAS runtime coordination with the program's PostgreSQL: Fabric (as-is, v0.2) claims and executes approved deterministic epochs; a versioned Moonshot schema publishes them by a guarded transaction (expected parent + chain generation), preserving C-008's transport-independent identity, duplicate/disagreement classification, separate validation and fail-closed contests; evidence materializes idempotently into Pan's Parquet/Iceberg lake; two-node demonstration with racing workers; a preregistered fleet benchmark if the two-node controls qualify.
sources: fabric/README.md, fabric/FREEZE.md, fabric/store.py, fabric/schema.sql, fabric/promexec/STATUS_EXPERIMENTAL.md; pan/iceberg.py, roles/Pan/docs/DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md; moonshot/epoch/CONTRACT.md (C-008)

Q1.description: mechanical: fixtures, manifests, reruns of a frozen benchmark

Q2.description: substantial: transactional schema, concurrency TDD, integration with Fabric and the lake

Q3.description: adversarial: authority boundaries, lost acknowledgements, crash windows, credential exposure

cadence.note: interface contract first; benchmark only if the two-node controls qualify
